title: Peach cobbler with biscuit topping
description: Ripe peaches bubbling under a tender, sugar-dusted biscuit topping. June made it all summer long.

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Toss the peaches with the sugar and cornstarch and spread them in a baking dish.
Whisk the flour and baking powder, then rub in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cream until a soft dough forms and drop spoonfuls over the peaches.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes until the topping is golden and the fruit bubbles at the edges.
